rv.q: Sweat grabs your brain, heart and soul from the first scene.

Staged with empathy and energy by master director, Andrea J Dymond, this talented cast reminds audiences of how our blue collar population continues to struggle to survive, while constantly being slighted.

Director Andrea J Dymond ‘s edgy production delivers on the promise that Copley Theatre, the highly anticipated, second jewel in Paramount Theatre’s crown, will be a dynamic new performance destination in Aurora’s revitalized and surging downtown cultural district.
You should take advantage of this exceptional production and go at once.
Cynthia ( played to perfection by Shariba Rivers) is promoted to a management position.
